verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party data export feature, such as a CSV or JSON export of sales, customers, or products, and no migration path for leaving Gumroad. The public REST API is only a developer building block from which a user could build their own export. The source-available code release concerns the application code, not the user's own data, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: public REST API for products, sales, subscribers, and licenses
